Timeline

[edit]
  • 2021
  • 2022
  • 2023
  • 2024
  • 2025
  • 2026
  • Show All
  • May 19th - Falcons Esports sign V1K1NG, varK, br0, BLACKEAGLE, and CacaNito. Additionally, DiM is signed as a substitute. [1]
  • August 10th - Falcons Esports sign JOXY. [2]
  • November 17th - Falcons Esports sign KrizzeN and n1ex on month-long contracts. Additionally, they acquire Remind on loan from NASR Esports for a month. [3]
  • November 19th - Falcons Esports part ways with br0, BLACKEAGLE, CacaNito, and DiM upon the expiration of their contracts. [4]
  • December 17th - Falcons Esports part ways with KrizzeN, n1ex, and Remind upon the expiration of their contracts. [3]
  • February 21st - Falcons Esports sign a new lineup consisting of Kyojin, hAdji, Maka, Keoz, Python and Ozstrik3r, the latter as coach. Additionally, they part ways with their remaining Saudi players. [5]
  • July 6th - Falcons Esports put Kyojin on medical leave due to a hand injury. [6]
  • August 14th - Team Falcons bench Keoz and sign NBK- and misutaaa to complete the roster. [7]
  • September 16th - Keoz is acquired by Team GamerLegion. [8]
  • October 25th - Team Falcons bench Maka. [9]
  • November 15th - Team Falcons acquire kennyS from G2 Esports. [10]
  • November 16th - Team Falcons part ways with Kyojin. [11]
  • January 21st - Team Falcons sign FeldmaN as their new analyst. [12]
  • January 24th - Team Falcons bench hAdji and sign bodyy as his replacement. Additionally, they release Maka. [13][14][15]
  • April 29th - Team Falcons release hAdji. [16]
  • May 7th - Team Falcons bench Python and move kennyS to a content creator position. [17]
  • June 17th - Team Falcons bench misutaaa. [18]
  • June 20th - Team Falcons acquire lauNX, mhL, and BOROS from Sprout, Endpoint, and Monte, respectively. [19]
  • July 28th - Team Falcons release misutaaa. [20]
  • August 30th - Team Falcons release Python upon the expiration of his contract. [21]
  • October 31st - Team Falcons part ways with Ozstrik3r. [22]
  • November 1st - Team Falcons sign zonic as coach. [23]
  • November 5th - Team Falcons bench NBK-, bodyy, lauNX and mhL. [24]
  • November 27th - bodyy is acquired by Fnatic. [25]
  • December 15th - Team Falcons sign Snappi. [26]
  • December 16th - Team Falcons acquire maden and SunPayus from ENCE, and Magisk from Team Vitality. [27]
  • January 2nd - Team Falcons loan lauNX to BLEED Esports. [28]
  • January 7th - Team Falcons loan mhL to 9INE. [29]
  • February 19th - Team Falcons bench BOROS and part ways with FeldmaN. [30]
  • February 23rd - mhL returns to Team Falcons' bench following the end of his loan to 9INE. [31]
  • March 8th - lauNX returns to Team Falcons' bench following the end of his loan to BLEED Esports. [32]
  • March 26th - Team Falcons acquire dupreeh from Preasy Esport. [33]
  • April 2nd - Team Falcons sign trochu as assistant coach. [34]
  • June 7th - NBK- and lauNX are acquired by Revenant Esports. [35]
  • July 10th - BOROS is acquired by Into The Breach. [36]
  • July 13th - Team Falcons part ways with mhL. [37]
  • September 27th - Team Falcons bench SunPayus and acquire s1mple from Natus Vincere on a three-month loan. [38]
  • November 21st - Team Falcons bench Snappi, maden, and dupreeh, and terminate s1mple's loan. [39]
  • January 3rd - Team Falcons acquire NiKo from G2 Esports while Snappi is acquired by an undisclosed organization, later revealed to be Ninjas in Pyjamas. [40][41]
  • January 4th - Team Falcons acquire TeSeS, kyxsan, and degster from HEROIC. [42]
  • January 8th - SunPayus is acquired by an undisclosed organization, later revealed to be HEROIC. [43]
  • April 14th - Team Falcons bench degster and acquire m0NESY from G2 Esports as his replacement. [44][45]
  • May 20th - Team Falcons release maden and dupreeh. [46]
  • June 23rd - Team Falcons bench Magisk and acquire kyousuke from Team Spirit Academy as his replacement. [47][48]
  • September 1st - Magisk is acquired by Astralis. [49]
  • December 17th - Team Falcons release degster. [50]
  • January 10th - Team Falcons sign Aymeinstein as an assistant coach while trochu transitions into being the team's analyst. [51]
  • February 9th - Team Falcons release trochu. [52]
  • April 20th - Team Falcons bench kyxsan and acquire karrigan from FaZe Clan as his replacement. [53][54]
  • June 21st - Team Falcons win the IEM Cologne 2026 Major, defeating FURIA 3-0 in the grand final.
  • July 8th - kyxsan is acquired by Aurora Gaming. [55]
